purpose: Financial evidence for decisions that cross institutions, funding systems and markets.
positioning: One company. Three connected products. Source-checkable financial research for people, software and AI agents.
audiences: Financial software and AI agent builders

global_strategy.distribution: Public websites, REST APIs and hosted MCP make the products accessible to international users, subject to applicable terms.
global_strategy.coverage: Worldwide access is distinct from jurisdiction and market coverage. Follow each product card and the source dates served with each result.
global_strategy.initial_commercial_focus: Repeatable institution monitoring and liquidity review for treasury, credit and research teams, starting with existing India and USD evidence.
global_strategy.expansion: Additional jurisdictions and enterprise integrations are expansion opportunities, subject to source rights, local definitions and validation.

products.name: LiquiLens
products.question: What is changing at this bank or lender?
products.coverage: India and US public institution research; European named case files. Jurisdiction-specific definitions and served evidence eligibility apply.
products.commercial_path: Public research and free integrations; named-list software proposals; separately scoped paid proof pilots.

products.name: Seiche
products.question: What funding environment surrounds this exposure?
products.coverage: Deepest institutional desk coverage is USD funding. Broader money-market, FX and economic reference coverage carries market-specific clocks, rights and availability states.
products.commercial_path: Free AGPL public core; potential commercial support and integration services must preserve the open-source licence.

products.name: Undertow
products.question: What does liquidity look like at this position size?
products.coverage: Cross-market public liquidity evidence; crypto exit estimates interpolate dated quote-depth bands. Gold scenarios require caller assumptions. Market segments can remain partial or unavailable.
products.commercial_path: Published Alerts, Agent and Desk plans; fund subscription offer; x402 machine-call pricing. Offers are not evidence of completed sales.

steps: Resolve an institution and inspect its dated public disclosures in LiquiLens.
Add relevant funding and money-market context from Seiche.
Inspect Undertow market liquidity or stated-size exit evidence when the exposure has a market exit.
Export a source-separated review and retain dates, assumptions and unavailable sections.
connected_workflow.contract: The products can be used independently. Their complementary evidence connects in browser and agent workflows; their scores are not merged into a universal risk verdict.

current_offers: LiquiLens named-list software and fixed-scope proof pilots
business_model.open_source_core: Seiche remains a free AGPL research core. Commercial support and integration are opportunities, not a change to that licence.
business_model.commercial_evidence: Published offers and live interfaces establish product availability. Revenue, customers and retention require separate dated evidence; traffic and tool calls are not customer proof.

capital_milestones: Prove repeated use and paid renewal for one institution-monitoring workflow.
Improve admitted source coverage, freshness and operating reliability for the markets buyers actually use.
Expand integrations and jurisdiction coverage only after rights and validation review.
Establish attributable acquisition, activation, retention and revenue reporting.
authority: Research and market data. No credit rating, regulatory approval, order execution or guaranteed investment or funding outcome.
